picks.title: India's Snabbit seeks fresh funding at a $400M valuation, sources say
picks.why_it_matters: A fast-scaling Indian gig/jobs platform hitting 1M jobs and raising at $400M signals strong traction in India's services marketplace category—worth tracking for competitive dynamics and potential co-investment or follow-on opportunities.

picks.title: America's Geothermal Breakthrough
picks.why_it_matters: A potential 150GW geothermal unlock represents a major emerging platform for climate tech startups in drilling, grid integration, and energy software—creating new investment categories beyond solar and wind.

picks.title: Amateur armed with ChatGPT solves an Erdős problem
picks.why_it_matters: Demonstrates LLMs enabling non-experts to make research breakthroughs, validating the 'AI copilot for specialized domains' thesis and signaling opportunities for vertical AI tools in science and R&D.
